017package org.apache.juneau.bean.html5;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
020
021/**
022 * DTO for an HTML <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/forms.html#the-meter-element">&lt;meter&gt;</a>
023 * element.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * The meter element represents a scalar measurement within a known range, or a fractional value.
027 * It is used to display a gauge or meter showing a value within a defined range, such as disk
028 * usage, memory usage, or progress. The meter element is not suitable for representing a range
029 * of values (use the input element with type="range" for that). It is typically rendered as a
030 * visual gauge or bar that shows the current value relative to the minimum and maximum values.
031 *
032 * <h5 class='section'>Examples:</h5>
033 * <p class='bcode w800'>
034 *    <jk>import static</jk> org.apache.juneau.bean.html5.HtmlBuilder.*;
035 *
036 *    <jc>// Simple meter</jc>
037 *    Meter <jv>simple</jv> = <jsm>meter</jsm>()
038 *       .value(50)
039 *       .min(0)
040 *       .max(100);
041 *
042 *    <jc>// Meter with styling</jc>
043 *    Meter <jv>styled</jv> = <jsm>meter</jsm>()
044 *       .class_(<js>"progress-meter"</js>)
045 *       .value(75)
046 *       .min(0)
047 *       .max(100);
048 *
049 *    <jc>// Meter with complex content</jc>
050 *    Meter <jv>complex</jv> = <jsm>meter</jsm>()
051 *       .value(60)
052 *       .min(0)
053 *       .max(100)
054 *       .low(25)
055 *       .high(75)
056 *       .optimum(50);
057 *
058 *    <jc>// Meter with ID</jc>
059 *    Meter <jv>withId</jv> = <jsm>meter</jsm>()
060 *       .id(<js>"disk-usage"</js>)
061 *       .value(80)
062 *       .min(0)
063 *       .max(100);
064 *
065 *    <jc>// Meter with styling</jc>
066 *    Meter <jv>styled2</jv> = <jsm>meter</jsm>()
067 *       .style(<js>"width: 200px; height: 20px;"</js>)
068 *       .value(40)
069 *       .min(0)
070 *       .max(100);
071 *
072 *    <jc>// Meter with multiple attributes</jc>
073 *    Meter <jv>multiple</jv> = <jsm>meter</jsm>()
074 *       .value(85)
075 *       .min(0)
076 *       .max(100)
077 *       .low(20)
078 *       .high(80)
079 *       .optimum(50)
080 *       .title(<js>"Disk Usage: 85%"</js>);
081 *
082 *    // Meter with form
083 *    Meter withForm = new Meter()
084 *       .form("usage-form")
085 *       .value(30)
086 *       .min(0)
087 *       .max(100);
088 * </p>
089 *
090 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
091 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauBeanHtml5">juneau-bean-html5</a>
092 * </ul>
093 */
094@Marshalled(typeName = "meter")
095public class Meter extends HtmlElementMixed<Meter> {
096
097   /**
098    * Creates an empty {@link Meter} element.
099    */
100   public Meter() {}
101
102   /**
103    * Creates a {@link Meter} element with the specified child nodes.
104    *
105    * @param children The child nodes. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
106    */
107   public Meter(Object...children) {
108      children(children);
109   }
110
111   /**
112    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/forms.html#attr-meter-high">high</a> attribute.
113    *
114    * <p>
115    * Low limit of high range.
116    *
117    * @param value
118    *    The new value for this attribute.
119    *    Typically a {@link Number} or {@link String}.
120    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
121    * @return This object.
122    */
123   public Meter high(Object value) {
124      attr("high", value);
125      return this;
126   }
127
128   /**
129    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/forms.html#attr-meter-low">low</a> attribute.
130    *
131    * <p>
132    * High limit of low range.
133    *
134    * @param value
135    *    The new value for this attribute.
136    *    Typically a {@link Number} or {@link String}.
137    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
138    * @return This object.
139    */
140   public Meter low(Object value) {
141      attr("low", value);
142      return this;
143   }
144
145   /**
146    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/forms.html#attr-meter-max">max</a> attribute.
147    *
148    * <p>
149    * Upper bound of range.
150    *
151    * @param value
152    *    The new value for this attribute.
153    *    Typically a {@link Number} or {@link String}.
154    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
155    * @return This object.
156    */
157   public Meter max(Object value) {
158      attr("max", value);
159      return this;
160   }
161
162   /**
163    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/forms.html#attr-meter-min">min</a> attribute.
164    *
165    * <p>
166    * Lower bound of range.
167    *
168    * @param value
169    *    The new value for this attribute.
170    *    Typically a {@link Number} or {@link String}.
171    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
172    * @return This object.
173    */
174   public Meter min(Object value) {
175      attr("min", value);
176      return this;
177   }
178
179   /**
180    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/forms.html#attr-meter-optimum">optimum</a> attribute.
181    *
182    * <p>
183    * Optimum value in gauge.
184    *
185    * @param value
186    *    The new value for this attribute.
187    *    Typically a {@link Number} or {@link String}.
188    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
189    * @return This object.
190    */
191   public Meter optimum(Object value) {
192      attr("optimum", value);
193      return this;
194   }
195
196   /**
197    * <a class="doclink" href="https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/forms.html#attr-meter-value">value</a> attribute.
198    *
199    * <p>
200    * Current value of the element.
201    *
202    * @param value
203    *    The new value for this attribute.
204    *    Typically a {@link Number} or {@link String}.
205    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset the attribute.
206    * @return This object.
207    */
208   public Meter value(Object value) {
209      attr("value", value);
210      return this;
211   }
212}
